source: APLIIQ help center shipping rate sheet (US standard)
repricingNote: APLIIQ reprices when USPS does. Re-verify this table against the APLIIQ help center whenever USPS announces a rate change, then bump effectiveDate. Never edit a rate without moving the date with it.

billing.note: Freight is billed SEPARATELY from product cost. APLIIQ also charges a fulfillment fee PER PRODUCT (per unit), not per order.

domestic.lookupNote: Tier steps are IRREGULAR — never assume a uniform step and never interpolate. Select the first tier whose maxWeightOz is greater than or equal to the shipped weight. A weight above the last tier has no published rate and must be an explicit error, never a clamp to the last row.

international.dutiesNote: International stays DDU: the customer pays duties and import taxes on delivery. The storefront charges one flat international shipping fee per order (lib/commerce/policies.ts INTERNATIONAL_SHIPPING_CENTS).

Populate `zones` from APLIIQ's published international table before selling outside the US; until then the landed-cost engine reports international freight as unmodelled and the flat-rate coverage check cannot pass.
